title: Express and check unsafe memory boundaries (experimental)
goal: Use experimental unsafe member contracts when a raw memory operation imposes caller obligations; review declaration accessibility and keep checked wrappers available.

selectionNotes: Experimental: enable LangVersion=preview, updated-memory-safety-rules and AllowUnsafeBlocks=true in projects using unsafe syntax.
public/internal/private still govern declaration accessibility; unsafe grants no access to private members.
Opted-in callers must acknowledge unsafe members; the member body separately needs an unsafe context. Legacy callers do not enforce pointer-free obligations.
RC2 pointer span construction still requires unsafe; the overview's project-setting removal claim is not reproduced.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The declared sample and framework reference assemblies target net11.0; no older-target route is claimed.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use a .NET 11 compiler with the documented preview and updated-memory-safety-rules switches; exact RC2 proof is recorded separately.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Experimental updated rules and unsafe expressions require LangVersion=preview, not ordinary C# 15.

prerequisites: Enable implicit usings and nullable; use the complete BeaconFrame source and the project settings in the offline body.
Both library and callers must opt into the updated model for the demonstrated caller checking.
constraints: A pointer alone proves neither validity nor length nor lifetime; the caller must guarantee two readable bytes.
unsafe on a member declares a caller obligation and does not authorize its body under the updated rules.
Declaration accessibility is unchanged; private/internal raw helpers remain inaccessible to unauthorized callers.
Keep pins alive through each read and reject short inputs before entering the raw reader.
Legacy-model consumers do not enforce pointer-free requires-unsafe contracts.
No AOT, native interop service, browser behavior or newer-SDK/older-target compatibility is established.
stabilityLimitations: Experimental RC2 compiler behavior, not stable C# 15 or GA proof; exact flags and metadata may change.
Actual RC2 pointer span construction contradicts the cumulative annotation-removal headline; do not omit AllowUnsafeBlocks for unsafe syntax.

sources.title: Library overview claim checked against actual RC2 artifacts

evidence.scope: Original beacon frame decoding with legacy unsafe contexts; exact expected readings, unchanged input and short-frame rejection executed on .NET 10.

Same real frame checks with experimental member/body/caller boundaries on RC2. Separate forced-rebuild consumer, attribute, accessibility, AllowUnsafeBlocks, pointer span and preview/legacy checks run through eng/Test-UnsafeBoundaries.ps1; its input bytes are hashed, but those compiler results are documented separately.

humanProof.scope: Portable memory decoding and compiler contracts are covered by actual compilation/execution. No native UI, provider, external account or deployment claim needs Human proof.
